texts.value: Catalyzes the dephosphorylation of N-acylneuraminate 9-phosphate (Neu5Ac-9-P) to N-acetylneuraminic acid (Neu5Ac or sialic acid) (PubMed:14235556, PubMed:16237198, PubMed:23747226). Can also use N-glycoloylneuraminate 9-phosphate as substrate (PubMed:14235556)
Inhibited by calcium (PubMed:16237198). Inhibited by vanadate, sodium orthovanadate and phosphonate (PubMed:16237198, PubMed:23747226)
Belongs to the HAD-like hydrolase superfamily. NANP family

comments.note: It seems to be derived from genomic DNA and not from cDNA.
